population: T3 returning participants and T3 controls with resolved coding
comparison: Participant minus control or participant divided by control
inference: Partially clustered CR2 95% CIs with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom

claim: The adjusted T3 association is similar to the raw association
estimand: Coefficient on participant indicator conditional on demographics
population: Complete cases among T3 returning participants and controls
inference: Partially clustered CR2 95% CI with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom

claim: Reason totals decline between T2 and T3 among returnees
population: Returning participants observed with resolved coding at both waves
inference: Group-clustered CR2 95% CI with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom

claim: The noncontemporaneous T2 participant contrast is larger
population: All usable T2 participants and T3 controls

claim: The participant gap is not concentrated in a clear directional shift

claim: Coding decisions are reproducible but imperfect

inference: Group-clustered CR2 95% CIs with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom
